SCHREINER-2014.verifiedSection: Ephesians 2:20 apostolic foundation; 1 Corinthians 13:8–12 not demonstrative of cessation

records.why: Existing TRENT record bundles Session VI justification and Eucharist, but definition of transubstantiation belongs to Session XIII. Specific Lutheran sacramental-union source is Formula of Concord VII. Do not change other questions citing TRENT.
CCC §2111 defines superstition generally; §2117 addresses occult magic and sorcery. Stage illusion is editorial application, not an example stated explicitly in §2117.

Separate first-person cessationist writer is now identified. Schreiner argues some extraordinary revelatory gifts were foundational, while admitting 1 Corinthians 13 does not by itself prove cessation. Does not speak for all Protestants and must not be represented as Pentecostal doctrine.
